human_guided: Train median for all continuous variables
ai_agent: per variable: Train mean when |skew| < 0.5, otherwise Train median
key_difference: the agent chooses the statistic per variable from the Training distribution
possible_methodological_implication: the median is robust for skewed variables; the mean is more efficient for symmetric ones. The practical difference is small when most variables are skewed

key_difference: the agent adds exactly one indicator
possible_methodological_implication: its adjusted coefficient was near zero, so it mainly occupies a coefficient; an arm A/B/C sensitivity analysis quantifies the effect

ai_agent: log1p on variables with Training skew >= +1.0 (RR, BUN, CRP, lymphocyte, D-dimer, lactate)
key_difference: the agent applies a stated rule and restricts it to right skew
possible_methodological_implication: applying log to a left-skewed variable worsens it; SpO2 (skew -2.10) is left untransformed in the agent pipeline

ai_agent: StandardScaler fitted on Train for LR and MLP; trees use raw values
key_difference: the agent does not scale inputs to the tree model
possible_methodological_implication: trees are invariant to monotone transforms, so this does not change the tree fit

human_guided: depth 3, lr 0.10, min_child_weight 1, subsample 0.8, colsample 0.8, scale_pos_weight 1.0, reg_alpha 0, reg_lambda 1, 25 trees (best iteration 24)
ai_agent: depth 3, lr 0.03, min_child_weight 10, subsample 0.8, colsample 0.8, scale_pos_weight 1.0, reg_lambda 1.0, n_estimators 300
key_difference: the agent chose a lower learning rate and a much higher min_child_weight
possible_methodological_implication: a higher min_child_weight forces more events per leaf, which constrains the tree in a 135-event problem

human_guided: early stopping on the Validation set
ai_agent: no early stopping; fixed 300 trees at lr 0.03, condition chosen by Training-internal CV
key_difference: the agent does not use Validation to stop training
possible_methodological_implication: using Validation to stop, to choose among conditions and to set the threshold makes the Validation estimate optimistic three times over

key_difference: the agent used a smaller network with more dropout
possible_methodological_implication: 12 inputs and 135 events give little support for a wide network

human_guided: AdamW, lr 1e-4, weight decay 1e-4, batch 64, pos_weight 1.0, best epoch 24
ai_agent: AdamW, lr 3e-4, weight decay 1e-3, batch 32, pos_weight 6.563, best epoch 15
key_difference: the agent used class weighting, a higher learning rate and stronger weight decay
possible_methodological_implication: pos_weight 6.563 raises predicted probabilities, which moves the operating threshold from 0.49 to 0.55 and affects calibration
